items.title: Dan Quinn had an "absolutely fantastic experience" coaching with Mike McCarthy
items.text: With Wednesday's rant from former Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers painting a negative picture about Steelers coach Mike McCarthy that extended to his time with both the Packers and the Cowboys, those who have worked with him in those places will inevitably be asked about McCarthy.

items.text: It's been all Steelers in the first quarter in Pittsburgh.

items.text: Bengals receiver Tee Higgins did not practice on Friday, but the injury should not keep him out of Sunday's game against the Saints.

items.title: Joe Milton III praises the Eagles, possibly criticizes the Cowboys
items.text: Eagles quarterback Joe Milton III returned to Texas on Thursday and threw a significant wrench into the Cowboys' postseason plans (and, possibly, Philly's thinly-veiled soft tank).

items.title: Steelers score first as T.J. Watt recovers Bo Nix fumble in end zone
items.text: There hasn't been any offense on display in Pittsburgh so far on Black Friday, but there has been a touchdown.

items.title: Kyler Murray off injury report, likely to be No. 2 QB vs. Falcons
items.text: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray is officially off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk will not play Sunday vs. Cardinals
items.text: While receiver Brandon Aiyuk joined the Commanders earlier this week, but his debut with the team will have to wait.

items.title: Commanders CB Amik Robertson to miss second straight game
items.text: The Commanders got a win over the Bengals without cornerback Amik Robertson and they'll try to do it again when they face the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Bears call Colston Loveland week-to-week with a knee injury
items.text: Bears tight end Colston Loveland went for tests on his injured knee after leaving Thursday's game in the first quarter and the team updated his condition on Friday.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers got no support from the Thanksgiving broadcasts
items.text: The day after former Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers went on TV and aired dirty laundry from the Pittsburgh locker room, none of the former quarterbacks (or other former players) who appear on TV supported him.

items.title: Falcons rule out WR Jahan Dotson, LG Matthew Bergeron
items.text: The Falcons have ruled out a couple of offensive starters for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

items.title: LB Cole Holcomb inactive for the Steelers on Friday
items.text: The most notable absence on the Steelers side of the field on Friday afternoon will be Aaron Rodgers, but the team also has players still on their roster who will not be playing against the Broncos.

items.title: Denzel Boston listed as questionable after missing Friday's practice
items.text: The Browns will be on Sunday Night Football this weekend, but it remains to be seen if rookie wide receiver Denzel Boston will be in their lineup.

items.title: Broncos, under Bo Nix, are much better at home than on the road
items.text: Lost in the ongoing drama in Pittsburgh is that they play the 8-2 Broncos today.

items.title: Christian Barmore questionable for Patriots, Alijah Vera-Tucker will travel to L.A.
items.text: Patriots defensive tackle Christian Barmore was added to the team's injury report on Friday and his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers is uncertain as a result.

items.title: T.J. Edwards: Fourth down pass to Jahmyr Gibbs a look we saw all week
items.text: The Bears had a hard time stopping Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs throughout Thursday's game in Detroit, so it made sense that the Lions put the ball in Gibbs's hands on fourth down with just over two minutes left to play.

items.text: The Giants welcomed linebacker Abdul Carter back to the practice field on Friday.

items.title: Mac Jones will start in Week 13 against the Seahawks.
items.text: Brock Purdy (ankle) has been ruled out, leaving Jones as the 49ers’ starter this week. Jones played very well in multiple starts last season, though he faces a tough Seahawks defense. Jones is a starter in two-quarterback leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: 49ers ruled out Brock Purdy (ankle) for Week 12 against the Seahawks.
items.text: Mac Jones will start in Purdy’s stead. 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said Purdy is dealing with a mid-ankle sprain, and the team is optimistic about his availability for Week 13 against the Giants. Jones piloted the offense efficiently last year and should be expected to do so again, albeit in a tough matchup this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: David Njoku (shoulder) is questionable for Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Njoku’s potential absence would allow Charlie Kolar, and theoretically Oronde Gadsden, to play more, but neither tight end qualifies as a top-12 option in that scenario. Justin Herbert (concussion) is also out. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Chargers ruled out Keaton Mitchell (knee) in Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Losing Mitchell helpfully condenses the Chargers’ backfield for fantasy purposes, though the offense will suffer with Justin Herbert (concussion) sidelined. Omarion Hampton is a volume-based RB2. Kimani Vidal is an RB3/4. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Chargers ruled out Justin Herbert (concussion) for Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Chargers backup QB DJ Uiagalelei is expected to start in Herbert’s stead. He threw a touchdown pass when Herbert left early due to a hand injury a few weeks back, but he is tough to rely on as anything more than a volatile QB2. Hopefully, Herbert can return for Week 13 against the Buccaneers. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) is not on the Seahawks’ final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.text: The Seahawks have managed Smith-Njigba’s reps in practice all year, and this week was no different. He was limited on Wednesday and Thursday, but should be fine for Sunday. Smith-Njigba is an elite WR1, as always, and gets Sam Darnold (quad) back this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Sam Darnold (quad) is not on the Seahawks’ final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.text: The Seahawks’ starting quarterback will make his return for a divisional showdown against the 49ers. Darnold has been fairly banged up this year, but hopefully the time off was good for him. He is a QB2 in Week 12. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (Achilles) will not play in Las Vegas’ Week 12 game against the Browns.
items.text: The instant rule-out and talk of a potentially serious injury has us believing Powers-Johnson will hit IR ahead of Sunday Night Football. Caleb Rogers and Trey Zuhn have played in Powers-Johnson’s absence this year and one of them will likely start against the Browns. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Raheim Sanders (hip) is questionable for Cleveland’s Week 12 game against the Raiders.
items.text: Todd Monken said he’s “hoping” to activate Sanders, who has only gotten in limited practices this week. He sounds truly questionable for Sunday Night Football. If active, Sanders will cut into Dylan Sampson’s backup workload a bit. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Browns signed LS Rex Sunahara to a four-year contract extension.
items.text: Sunahara, 30 years young, has been the Browns’ snapper of balls that go longer than the league average since 2024. He’s now inked through his age-34 season. - Rivers McCown
